user.title: Connect Google Nest
user.description: Use your Device Access project ID and Google OAuth credentials. Only the SDM API is used; event subscriptions are not needed. Obtain a refresh token with scripts/authorize.py in the repository.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew Google authorization
reauth_confirm.description: Authorize the same Google account and Device Access project again, then enter the replacement refresh token. Leave the client secret empty to keep the existing one.

error.invalid_project: Enter the UUID from the Nest Device Access Console, not the Google Cloud project name.
error.invalid_auth: Google rejected the credentials. Obtain a new refresh token for this OAuth client.
error.forbidden: SDM access was denied. Check the API, Device Access project and selected devices in Partner Connections.
error.rate_limited: Google is rate limiting requests. Wait a minute and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Google SDM. Try again later.
error.no_thermostats: No thermostats were returned. Select a thermostat in Google Partner Connections.
error.wrong_account: Use the same Google account as this integration entry.

abort.already_configured: This Google user and Device Access project are already configured.

init.title: Polling and fan timer
init.description: All entities share one device-list request per interval. Fan On starts a timed run; Auto cancels that timer while allowing HVAC-controlled operation.

error.invalid_options: Use a refresh interval of 30–900 seconds and a fan duration of 1–720 minutes.

unsupported_mode.message: This thermostat does not support the requested mode.

invalid_temperature.message: The target must be a finite temperature between 9 and 32 °C.

range_required.message: Heat/cool mode needs a low and a high target temperature.

invalid_range.message: The cooling target must be at least 1.5 °C above the heating target.

single_temperature_required.message: Use a single target temperature in heating or cooling mode.

thermostat_off.message: The thermostat is OFF. Select a heating/cooling mode explicitly first.

eco_active.message: Turn off the Eco preset before changing target temperatures.

unsupported_preset.message: This thermostat does not support the requested preset.

unsupported_fan.message: This thermostat does not support the requested fan setting.

device_unavailable.message: The thermostat is offline or no longer shared with this integration.

invalid_auth.message: Google authorization expired. Reauthenticate the integration.

rate_limited.message: Google SDM rate limit reached. Try again in {seconds} seconds.

command_failed.message: Google could not confirm the requested action. Check the thermostat before retrying.

command_rejected.message: Google rejected this command. Check the current thermostat mode and capabilities.
